description: This file is a shell script containing functions to prepare, verify, and synchronize pull request branches in a Git-based development workflow. It includes procedures for initializing the environment, validating commit messages, pushing updates to PR branches, and performing rebase operations with associated gate checks.

methods.name: checkout_prep_branch
methods.description: Checks out the prepared branch for a given pull request by resolving its name and verifying its existence.

methods.name: resolve_prep_branch_name
methods.description: Resolves the name of the preparation branch for a given pull request, defaulting to 'pr-{pr}-prep' if not specified.

methods.name: verify_prep_branch_matches_prepared_head
methods.description: Verifies that the local prep branch contains the expected commit hash, providing diagnostics and instructions if not.

methods.name: prepare_init
methods.description: Initializes the prepare environment for a PR, fetching data, setting up branches, and creating context files.

methods.name: prepare_validate_commit
methods.description: Validates that the latest commit message of the PR does not contain PR number or thanks annotations, conforming to commit standards.

methods.name: prepare_push
methods.description: Pushes the prepared branch to the PR branch, verifies HEAD states, and records relevant metadata.

methods.name: prepare_sync_head
methods.description: Synchronizes the prep branch with the latest main branch, rebasing if necessary, and updates the context and gate status.

methods.name: prepare_run
methods.description: Executes the entire preparation process: init, gate checks, and push, for a given PR.
